name: joint model-kernel-hardware co-design
model_specific_reason: The combined Qwen3-8B variant changes weights, KV precision, KV geometry, feed-forward width, kernel fusion, and the resulting memory/compute/interconnect balance together.
mechanism: Every model change is followed by hardware re-sizing, mapping, SLO capacity planning, and TCO allocation; this captures discontinuous changes such as dropping devices or replicas that isolated tensor savings miss.
